summary: The finite atomic centerpoint construction in the intrinsic affine space is valid, including r=0, coincident centers, and constant restricted normals. The selected point lies in the actual origin fiber before any halfspace is chosen. The conditional symmetry estimate and base inversion use the original fiber-volume law and give the stated bound for every ambient normal and every containing closed halfspace. The homothetic convexity, compactness, full dimensionality, complete positive support, boundary fibers, center uniqueness, rank bound, and both cube normalization maps all follow as claimed. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
